mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_flow_business WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM sys_flow_business WHERE business_key = #{businessKey} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM sys_flow_business
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT title_source.title FROM sys_flow_business title_source WHERE title_source.process_def_key = business.process_def_key AND title_source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND title_source.title IS NOT NULL AND title_source.title != '' ORDER BY title_source.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), business.process_def_key ) AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM sys_flow_business business WHERE business.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business.process_def_key IS NOT NULL AND business.process_def_key != '' GROUP BY business.process_def_key ORDER BY value DESC, business.process_def_key ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN business.status IN ('running', 'active') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runningInstances, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_flow_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.status IN (0, 1) ) AS pendingTasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN business.end_time IS NOT NULL AND business.end_time >= #{startOfDay} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCompleted, 0 AS timeoutTasks FROM sys_flow_business business WHERE business.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
